notes.title: Update 0.5 Released - Month of September Report
notes.notes:
Hello again! This month's update contains some new content including a new game mode, as well as a new weapon and map.

Elimination is a game mode that can be played offline or with a friend online against AI. Up to 2 police officers try to eliminate 20 criminals that spawn randomly on the map. The AI has been significantly buffed for this patch, so prepare for a fight. 

Also added was the ability to spawn a police bot. This will allow you to force all players in the lobby to be criminals or to play offline as a criminal.

Finally, the newest content to the game is the dual smgs for the criminals and the mansion map. 


Changelog:

    Added dual smgs for criminals
    Added mansion map
    Added elimination game mode
Added local network capability
Buffed AI
Fixed minor bugs
Added trading cards

notes.title: Update 0.4 Released - Month of August Report
notes.notes:
Hello again! This month's update is a big one. It contains a lot of quality of life improvements as well as content. First off there is a new weapon selection screen which shows up at the start of every round and will replace the old pickup system. This allows for short breaks in between rounds to decide what loadout you would like to use. 

Secondly, there is a new map, Warehouse, as well as a re-design to the old map Drug House. 

Thirdly, two new abilities have been added: flashbangs for the cops, and a wrench for the criminals.

Lastly, bullets were re-implemented as hitscan rather than physical. Before this update it may have been hard to hit people who lived in regions far away from you. This occured because the physical bullets were very demanding on the network. To fix this, I replaced the old system with hitscan and through testing it has proven to be a much better solution. Please send any feedback about this new system to the discussions board.

There is also a bunch of models that have been re-designed. Check the changelog for more.

Also, if you would like to get future updates quicker (but less stable) switch over to the Testing branch of the game in the betas tab.

That's all for this month, happy bank robbing!


Changelog:

Added wrench for criminals
Added flashbangs for cops
Added warehouse map
Weapon selection screen
New drughouse terrain design
Redesigned smg model for cops
Redesigned blowtorch, grenade, molotov, riot shield, baseball bat, smoke grenade, and moneybag models
Bullets are now hitscan
New UI for menus
Buffed AI
Fixed minor bugs

notes.title: Recession Early Access Release and Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to the early access release for Recession! It's been a long year but the time has finally come. I hope you all enjoy it, and of course, if you have any feedback, feel free to post on the discussion forums or the subreddit/discord. 

The aim is to have the game fully complete in 8-12 months. This is a rather large window because the game may change over the course of time and deadlines may be pushed back depending on your feedback. Your suggestions will help shape the game and because of that, dates may have to get moved around. But, I am confident that in a year from now, the game will be feature-complete.

Here is a roadmap for the next few months of Recession:
July 2017:

    Bug fixing and server testing
    New map
    New music
    UI Improvements


August 2017:

    Quality of life improvements
    New map
    New abilities for criminal and police


September 2017:

    New map
    New weapons



TBA 2017:

    New clothing items for characters
    Singleplayer/Coop Police Gamemode
    Polished 3rd and 1st person animations


That is all for today. Happy bank robbing!
